name: Some Beaches (Laketown, UT) Famous "Oreo Fat Boy" Hand-Spun Shake
whyItWorks: Made with rich vanilla ice cream and crushed Oreo cookies. Seed-free, making it far safer for strictures than seeded raspberry shakes, though high in dairy lactose.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a small Oreo Fat Boy shake; take a lactase enzyme tablet if lactose sensitive.
watchOuts: High in dairy lactose and sugar; share portion
